name: Seiko Open Heart
ref: Seiko ladies Automatic Open Heart, cal. 4R38 (dial code 4R38-0402; JDM twin: Seiko Selection SSDE008)

strap.shape: closed loop in the YZ plane (from the 12h lugs around -Z to the 6h lugs)

hands.units: metres, model frame (origin = caseback centre, +Z out of the dial, +Y = 12 o'clock, +X = 3 o'clock)
hands.usage: Each outline is a closed 2D polygon in the hand frame (+Y from the pivot toward the tip). Build THREE.Shape(outline) -> ExtrudeGeometry({depth: thickness, bevelEnabled: false}), place at [pivot.x, pivot.y, z] and rotate about +Z by -angle (clock angle, clockwise seen from +Z). Draw lumeOutline as a second extrusion from z with depth thickness + lumeRaise. Hour < minute < second < cap in z.
hands.angles: hour = 30*(h%12 + m/60 + s/3600) deg, minute = 6*(m + s/60) deg, second = 6*s deg with s quantised to 1/sweepHz
hands.sweepNote: cal. 4R38 (21,600 vph) -> seconds hand advances in 6 steps per second
